# pmon_column_tags (Data Source)

Only the columns of a datasource that carry tags.

An empty result on a production datasource is worth noticing: the shipped presets read every column `unless resource in Tag::"pii"`, so with nothing tagged that exclusion never fires and the whole datasource is readable in cleartext.

Mask functions are not reported here; pmon's read tools do not expose which one a column carries.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pmon_column_tags" "finance" {
  datasource = "example-finance-rw"
}

# An empty result on a production datasource means the shipped presets' `unless resource in
# Tag::"pii"` exclusion never fires, so every column is readable in cleartext.
output "finance_is_unclassified" {
  value = length(data.pmon_column_tags.finance.columns) == 0
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `datasource` (String) Datasource to read.

### Read-Only

- `columns` (Attributes List) The classified columns. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Read-Only:

- `column` (String) Column name.
- `schema` (String) Schema holding the table.
- `table` (String) Table holding the column.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags on the column.
